name: Santa Monica Proper Hotel
insider_take: This sleek boutique gem sits just four blocks from Santa Monica Pier, where modern luxury meets California beach culture in perfect harmony.
whats_special: The hotel features stunning rooftop views of the Pacific Ocean and houses Onda, an acclaimed Spanish restaurant by Chef Jessica Koslow. The building's distinctive curved architecture was designed by Howard Roark, creating an Instagram-worthy backdrop against Santa Monica's iconic palm-lined streets.
pro_tip: Book a corner suite facing west for unobstructed sunset views over the Pacific, and make dinner reservations at Onda well in advance – it's consistently booked by both guests and locals.
dont_miss: The Third Street Promenade's street performers and Santa Monica Pier's solar-powered Ferris wheel are practically at your doorstep. Rent a bike and cruise the 22-mile Marvin Braude Bike Trail, or catch golden hour at Palisades Park's bluffs overlooking the ocean.
pros: Prime Santa Monica location near beach and Third Street Promenade
Stunning rooftop bar and restaurant with panoramic city views
Sophisticated design with locally-inspired art and modern amenities
Exceptional dining options including acclaimed Onda restaurant
cons: Urban setting with typical city noise levels
